environment.note: Measured on 2026-09-17 against the live session on 127.0.0.1:9877 (Ableton Live running, 32 tracks, vendored AbletonMCP remote script).

failures.cause: PRE-EXISTING / ENVIRONMENTAL. Asserts exit code 2 (blocked); Ableton is actually running on this machine so the probe legitimately succeeds and returns 0.
PRE-EXISTING TEST BUG. When Live IS reachable the test calls adapter.disconnect() and then adapter.health(), which raises 'Not connected'. The test cannot pass in a Live-present environment.

regression.conclusion: No regression introduced. The same three tests fail before and after; all three depend on Ableton being absent.

quantisation.meaning: Live main-thread scheduler tick. Payload size is irrelevant; RPC count is everything.

ableton_rpc.payload_vs_latency: 174KB costs 0.63s; 196 bytes costs 0.43s. Bytes are not the cost.

local_cpu_and_io.conclusion: Filesystem, hashing and DSP are NOT bottlenecks. Caching DSP output would save ~22ms against a 15s capture. Do not optimise here.

model_pipeline.conclusion: Astra is 100% provider-bound. The only levers are fewer calls, lower reasoning effort, and overlapping it with other work.

capture.classification: INTRINSIC_AUDIO_DURATION for the playback; everything else is overhead.

not_measured: producer-analyze end to end (mutates the live session; not run without authorisation)
project-ready end to end (bootstrap_project(apply=True) can create capture host tracks)
import-project / project launch (kills and relaunches Ableton)
a live Astra call (spends provider budget; 85 recorded samples used instead)
